messages:
ella: Hey team — customer (iOS app v3.2.1) reports the stream returns a partial JSON payload and then the connection drops. They show the UI with a truncated object and got charged for the tokens. Repro steps below, can someone triage?

sarah: sorry to hear that — can you paste the request_id + a minimal repro? also are they on our SDK or direct REST?

ella: using our JS SDK (v1.8.0) embedded in the mobile webview. request_id=rq_20260315_981, connection_id=conn_0x7a9. Repro steps: 1) start a streaming completion, 2) after ~25-35s toggle VPN on (iPhone hotspot -> corporate VPN), 3) stream returns a partial JSON and the client shows error. Happens ~8/10 attempts.

ella: minimal curl we used to compare (non-WS SSE):
```
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/streams?model=gpt-open"
```

ella: app logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:05:12Z] incoming rq_20260315_981 conn=conn_0x7a9 user=acct_42
[2026-03-15T14:05:42Z] stream: sent chunk idx=12 bytes=384
[2026-03-15T14:05:44Z] net: client FIN from 10.1.12.83 -> edge
[2026-03-15T14:05:44Z] edge: upstream: write tcp: connection reset by peer (broken pipe)
[2026-03-15T14:05:44Z] billing: tokens=128 charged=true
```

ella: customer wants to know if we can avoid charging when the client never received final JSON. Also worried about partial state being stored.

sarah: ack — first look suggests the client closes TCP when VPN switches, which causes upstream to error. We need edge + proxy logs (nginx/ingress) and trace id. Do you have the edge trace header (x-redwood-trace)?

ella: trace header was trace-7f9a3c. attaching full ingress lines above. No 5xx on the backend app, looks like proxy returned upstream error when trying to flush.

mike: from eng-runtime: that pattern (client FIN then upstream write fails) typically means the TCP socket was closed mid-chunk. For SSE/streaming we currently count tokens as soon as the runtime emits them, before client ACK. That explains billing.

james: I queried the ingress logs around trace-7f9a3c — the nginx LB produced a 502 for that request with body "upstream prematurely closed connection" at 14:05:44. I can share the log snippet if useful.

sarah: useful, thanks. Two asks: (1) can we make an immediate customer-facing workaround? (2) do we need an engineering fix to avoid billing for truncated streams?

mike: short-term workaround: ask customers to enable client-side reconnect + dedupe using session_id so the SDK can re-attach and request resume. For SSE we can add a small client-side buffer + retry to avoid immediate UI error. Server-side mitigation: mark request as aborted and flag tokens as disputed when upstream errors and client disconnected before final close — needs billing approval.

mike: longer-term fix: change billing semantics to bill for only fully-delivered responses or implement a server-side commit point (e.g., bill when we emit a final event). That affects analytics and many customers; need PM + billing input. Filed INC-789 for engineering investigation.

sarah: I created a billing ticket BILL-452 to hold charges pending investigation. @billing-team please review tokens for rq_20260315_981.

james: repro suggestion for eng: try to reproduce by switching the local IP mid-request. Example test (linux):
```
# start streaming curl on eth0
curl -N --interface eth0 ... &
# after a few seconds, bring eth0 down and route via wlan0
sudo ip link set eth0 down
```

ella: shared with customer; they can try SDK reconnection and will report back. They asked if we can refund this one if we don't change billing model.

deploy-bot: Escalation created -> INC-789 assigned to eng-runtime; billing ticket BILL-452 created.

mike: I'll repro in the office with a VPN appliance and then draft a proposal: (a) keep current immediate-billing but auto-flag truncated requests for manual review, (b) evaluate commit-point billing for streaming (impact analysis). I'll post findings in INC-789.

ella: thanks — please ping here when you have an ETA. I told the customer we'll pause any charge until BILL-452 completes.

sarah: noted. keeping this thread open — adding action items to the support case. :thumbsup:
